EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows an aromatic/heteroaromatic pattern: strong bands at 1609, 1572, 1522, 1428 cm⁻¹ (aromatic C=C region) and an sp2 C–H stretch at 3082 cm⁻¹ consistent with unsaturated rings (GFQ-003). Two intense bands at 1235 and 1157 cm⁻¹ are characteristic of C–O stretches in a lactone/heteroaromatic ester system, which fits a pyrone ring. A band at 632 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a C–halogen stretch region (cf. halogen stretches 611–651 cm⁻¹ in GFQ-046), matching the Br substituent. Crucially, there is no N–H stretch near 3300–3400 cm⁻¹, which disfavors candidates with N–H (GFQ-002). Among NH-free candidates, only O=c1cc(Br)cco1 (index 5) contains a lactone (to account for both 1157 and 1235 cm⁻¹) and a halogen (to account for ~632 cm⁻¹). Candidate 1 lacks a C–O single bond, making the paired 1157/1235 features less plausible, and candidate 2 would exhibit dominant Si–Cl modes not observed.
